Bungee Jumping in Rishikesh Overview

The Thrill of Bungee Jumping in Rishikesh
Bungee jumping in Rishikesh is a heart-pounding activity that allows you to conquer your fears and experience an exhilarating freefall. At Thrill Factory, you'll have the opportunity to take a leap from India's highest fixed platform, standing at a staggering height. As you prepare to jump, the adrenaline coursing through your veins, you'll be rewarded with breathtaking views of the surrounding natural beauty. The rush of adrenaline and the feeling of weightlessness during the descent make bungee jumping an unforgettable adventure.
Safety and Professionalism: When it comes to bungee jumping, safety is paramount, and Thrill
Factory ensures that every precaution is taken to provide a secure and thrilling experience to ensure highest level of adrenline rush. The highly trained staff and state-of-the-art equipment adhere to strict safety standards, ensuring that your bungee jumping experience in Rishikesh is both thrilling and safe. From thorough safety briefings to expert harnessing and jump supervision, you can trust that your adventure at Thrill Factory will be in capable hands.
  • Thrill Factory Bungee Jumping in Shivpuri is meticulously designed and constructed by Mark Charles with a team of expert professionals from United Kingdom.
  • We prioritize your safety and provide you with appropriate safety equipment to ensure a secure bungee jumping experience. Throughout the activity, experienced and well-trained professionals will guide you every step of the way.
  • To ensure your safety, the rope used for the bungee jump will be adjusted based on your weight. Our trained staff will ensure that your chest and ankles are securely fastened with the safety rope. Before taking the leap, our trainers will provide you with proper guidance and instructions to ensure you are well-prepared for the jump.
  • It's worth mentioning that the Thrill Factory Bungee Jumping platform in Shivpuri is widely recognized as one of the safest in the country.
  • While the height may seem daunting, it's important to have faith in our experts and take the plunge. They have extensive experience and will be there to support you throughout the entire process. Additionally, we kindly request that you inform your guide of any medical conditions you may have prior to the jump.
So, put aside any worries about safety, trust in our team of experts, and embrace the exhilarating adventure of bungee jumping.

Thrill Factory Bungee Jumping FAQs
Q1: What are the operating hours for the Bungee Jumping activity at Thrill Factory in Rishikesh?
The Bungee Jumping activity at Thrill Factory in Rishikesh operates between 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
Q2: How safe is the bungee jumping experience at Thrill Factory?
Safety is our top priority at Thrill Factory. We have a team of highly trained professionals who adhere to strict safety standards. Our bungee jumping platform is designed by a team from the United Kingdom, and we use state-of-the-art equipment to ensure a secure and thrilling experience. You will receive thorough safety briefings, expert harnessing, and constant supervision to make your bungee jumping adventure safe and enjoyable.
Q3: How high is the bungee jumping platform at Thrill Factory in Rishikesh?
The bungee jumping platform at Thrill Factory in Rishikesh stands at a staggering height of 165 feet, making it India's highest fixed platform for bungee jumping.
Q4: Can anyone participate in the bungee jumping activity, or are there any weight restrictions??
While bungee jumping is an exhilarating adventure, your safety is our priority. The rope used for the jump will be adjusted based on your weight, and our trained staff will securely fasten your chest and ankles with the safety rope. We welcome participants of varying weights, and our experienced professionals will ensure you have a safe and thrilling experience.
Q5: How do I book a bungee jumping session with Thrill Factory in Rishikesh?
Booking a bungee jumping session with Thrill Factory is easy. You can visit our official website and choose the date and time that suits you best. Alternatively, you can also contact our customer support team via phone or email, and they will assist you with the booking process.
